claims: 'Claude just killed any startup that was helping you get a job'
Apify can fetch the most recent job openings so you can be first to apply
A LinkedIn data export contains your connections, conversation history and who has responded to you
how_to_steps: LinkedIn profile -> Resources -> 'Save to PDF'; upload to Claude with a prompt to optimize headline and experience for inbound

Run an Apify LinkedIn jobs scrape, attach the JSON to Claude: 'Rank the 3 best matches in my attached Apify results. My background: ... Give company, role, one short fit reason and one gap. Link each source. Use only the returned listings; do not claim verified availability.'

Attach resume + job description: 'Tailor my attached resume to the attached job description. Return 3 matching ATS keywords, a sharper summary and one rewritten experience bullet. Flag missing requirements. Use only evidence from my resume; invent no experience or scores. Under 100 words.'

LinkedIn Settings -> Data Privacy -> download your data; give the CSVs to Claude Code and ask: 'Rank 3 contacts from my attached LinkedIn export for consumer-AI Product Manager roles. Use only company, title and connection date. Give each name.'
